name: Circular Progress
description: Animated ring gauge showing a value against a maximum, with the value in the center. One gauge (partial) or a row of labelled gauges (report).
helpText: Map Value (and optionally Maximum) to numeric columns. The ring animates from zero on load and after region refresh; users with reduced motion see it without animation. Non-numeric values show an empty ring.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.helpText: Current numeric value, with a period as decimal separator.

attributes.name: Maximum
attributes.helpText: Value of a full ring. Defaults to 100.

attributes.name: Center Text
attributes.helpText: Text in the middle of the ring, for example 72% or 8/12. Leave empty to show the percentage computed from Value and Maximum.

attributes.name: Label
attributes.helpText: Caption under the ring. Also the accessible name.

attributes.name: State
attributes.helpText: Optional success, warning, danger or info. Anything else uses the primary color.
